info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Property Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Property Portfolio Management API provides access to details regarding a bank's property portfolio. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific information about various facilities associated with properties, making it valuable for financial analysts, property managers, and decision-makers. Typical use cases include analyzing property performance, assessing asset value, and managing investment strategies. Developers can incorporate this API to enhance their applications with property insights and facilitate informed decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve facility details by property ID
get.description: This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific facility based on the provided property ID. It is designed to help users access facility-related data efficiently.
